SELECT
    ts.id AS typeform_survey_id,
    ts.contact_id AS survey_contact_id,
    ts.form_id,
    ts.hash AS survey_hash,
    ts.token,
    ts.locale AS survey_locale,
    ts.points_result,
    ts.form_response,
    ts.submitted_at AS survey_submitted_at,
    c_final.id AS contact_id,
    c_final.id AS final_contact_id,
    CASE
        WHEN c_direct.coach_id IS NOT NULL AND c_direct.coach_id <> 1 THEN c_direct.coach_id
        WHEN c_email.coach_id IS NOT NULL THEN c_email.coach_id
        WHEN u_slug.id IS NOT NULL THEN u_slug.id
        ELSE c_direct.coach_id
    END AS coach_id,
    c_final.member_id,
    c_final.email AS contact_email,
    c_final.first_name AS contact_first_name,
    c_final.last_name AS contact_last_name,
    c_final.phone_prefix AS contact_phone_prefix,
    c_final.phone_number AS contact_phone_number,
    c_final.locale AS contact_locale,
    u.id AS final_coach_id,
    u.first_name AS coach_first_name,
    u.last_name AS coach_last_name,
    u.herbalife_id AS coach_herbalife_id,
    u.email AS coach_email,
    u.sub_domain AS coach_sub_domain,
    o.org_name AS coach_organisation_name,
    u.area_code AS coach_area_code,
    u.phone_number AS coach_phone_number,
    u.preferred_newsletter_language AS coach_preferred_language
FROM prod_contacts_activesupport.typeform_surveys ts
JOIN prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts c_direct
    ON c_direct.id = ts.contact_id
LEFT JOIN prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts c_email
    ON c_email.id = (
        SELECT c2.id
        FROM prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts c2
        WHERE c_direct.email IS NOT NULL
          AND LOWER(c2.email) = LOWER(c_direct.email)
          AND c2.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND c2.coach_id IS NOT NULL
          AND c2.coach_id <> 1
        ORDER BY c2.updated_at DESC, c2.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.users u_slug
    ON LOWER(u_slug.sub_domain) = LOWER(COALESCE(
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(ts.form_response) THEN ts.form_response ELSE NULL END, '$.form_response.hidden.berater_slug')), ''),
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(ts.form_response) THEN ts.form_response ELSE NULL END, '$.hidden.berater_slug')), ''),
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(ts.form_response) THEN ts.form_response ELSE NULL END, '$.form_response.hidden.slug')), ''),
        NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(ts.form_response) THEN ts.form_response ELSE NULL END, '$.hidden.slug')), '')
    ))
LEFT JOIN prod_contacts_activesupport.contacts c_final
    ON c_final.id = CASE
        WHEN c_direct.coach_id IS NOT NULL AND c_direct.coach_id <> 1 THEN c_direct.id
        WHEN c_email.id IS NOT NULL THEN c_email.id
        ELSE c_direct.id
    END
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.users u
    ON u.id = CASE
        WHEN c_direct.coach_id IS NOT NULL AND c_direct.coach_id <> 1 THEN c_direct.coach_id
        WHEN c_email.coach_id IS NOT NULL THEN c_email.coach_id
        WHEN u_slug.id IS NOT NULL THEN u_slug.id
        ELSE c_direct.coach_id
    END
LEFT JOIN prod_activesupport.organizations o
    ON o.id = u.organization_id
LEFT JOIN prod_contacts_activesupport.lead_processing_jobs lpj
    ON lpj.typeform_survey_id = ts.id
WHERE ts.form_id IN ('hC2yTcU8')
  AND ts.submitted_at >= '{{ $json.activation_time }}'
  AND lpj.id IS NULL
ORDER BY ts.submitted_at ASC
LIMIT {{ $json.batch_limit }};

UPDATE prod_contacts_activesupport.lead_processing_jobs
SET
    status = 'processed',
    coach_email_sent_at = NOW(),
    coach_email_message_id = {{ $json.postmark_message_id ? "'" + String($json.postmark_message_id).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    contact_email_queued_at = {{ $json.lead_email_message_id ? 'NOW()' : 'NULL' }},
    contact_email_reference = {{ $json.lead_email_message_id ? "'" + String($json.lead_email_message_id).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : ($json.mautic_contact_id ? "'" + String($json.mautic_contact_id).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL') }},
    mautic_synced_at = NOW(),
    mautic_contact_id = {{ $json.mautic_contact_id || 'NULL' }},
    mautic_segment_alias = {{ $json.mautic_segment_alias ? "'" + String($json.mautic_segment_alias).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    processed_at = NOW(),
    locked_at = NULL,
    locked_by = NULL,
    last_error = NULL,
    next_attempt_at = NULL
WHERE id = {{ $json.job_id }};

UPDATE prod_contacts_activesupport.lead_processing_jobs
SET
    status = CASE
        WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'dead'
        ELSE 'failed'
    END,
    last_error = '{{ String($json.last_error || "Unknown error").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    next_attempt_at = CASE
        WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN NULL
        ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(60, POW(2, attempts)) MINUTE)
    END,
    locked_at = NULL,
    locked_by = NULL
WHERE id = {{ $json.job_id }};
